blocks.text: AT THE TIME, VICE PRESIDENT BIDEN SAID THEY HADN'T DONE MUCH. TEN YEARS OF SUBURBIA FOR NOTHING?
IT WASN'T WHAT THEY DID THAT MATTERED. IT WAS WHAT THEY COULD HAVE BECOME. A WELL-PLACED NEIGHBOUR. A FAMILY FRIEND IN THE RIGHT MINISTRY.
AND THE TWO BOYS? OVERNIGHT, THEY FIND OUT THEIR PARENTS ARE RUSSIAN...
THEY WERE PUT ON THE PLANE WITH THEM. TO MOSCOW. A COUNTRY WHOSE LANGUAGE THEY DIDN'T EVEN SPEAK. YOUR SERIES ISN'T FICTION, MADEMOISELLE. IT'S A RERUN.
